opened by sync-s2a6 (#2100 review): #507 kill switch: upstream removed try_start_turn_if_idle; turn.rs refuses the turn, but turn_input.rs StartIfIdle should refuse up front while the kill switch is on. Resolved by sync-compile17: start_if_idle (StartIfIdle and ContinueIfIdle) returns NotSubmitted { KillSwitch } before reserving or recording anything while the switch is on (new protocol NotSubmittedReason::KillSwitch, main's TryStartTurnIfIdleRejectionReason::KillSwitch); a person's start-or-steer turn drains ready agent mail into its first request again (main's spawn_regular_turn_for_no_active_input), so mail held while the switch was on goes with the next turn. Tests: issue_507_switch_off (4), issue_445_agent_messages_wait_while_the_kill_switch_is_on. Review round 1: the mail drain is skipped whenever turn_refusal() would refuse the turn (kill switch or #1331 removed/signed-out account), so a refused turn leaves the mail queued (test issue_445_refused_turn_leaves_agent_messages_queued); a refusal that starts between that check and run_turn can still drop drained mail from the live session, as on main. Unlike main, the drained mail's start options (parent_turn_id) are not applied, consistent with the sync branch's start_task path.
